fair_input_rule: Use the original twelve questions, finite catalog and synthetic context. No expected labels, human_gold, previous Jev output or repository enrichment is supplied to the host.

semantic_adapter.shared: Reuse baseline required and forbidden selections, allowed detail/completeness/hierarchy/status choices, original-question preservation, and conditional required-fields checks.
semantic_adapter.unsupported_need: The host path has no probabilities. N10's needs_outside_catalog predicate means explicit needs_outside_catalog in unresolved and status needs_resolution. Do not fabricate a confidence value.
semantic_adapter.transport: Grade transport separately: kernel waits with an actual host packet and input artifact, accepts one matching schema-bound host submission, completes that run with one host operation and zero Jev calls. This does not establish one underlying model request or token usage.
semantic_adapter.score_reporting: Keep original Jev 7/12 frozen-gold result unchanged. Compare shared semantic predicates separately, and label new minimality checks as a prospective overlay, not a changed baseline.

overlay.reason: An exact criteria question does not require test-link declarations, lifecycle/progress or hierarchy/code facts; supporting discussion must not create required retrieval obligations.
A question explicitly requesting two status fields requires those statuses and attribution, not full criteria or test specifications.
These unbound discovery questions must not demand a named target before source discovery.
When the answer requires a schema/contract entity, the source plan must not silently omit its contract document type.

not_measured: host token usage unless actually known
